column1: # Worked pin placements for tuning the scoring curve. Each row is somewhere a
# real player might plausibly click, with the band it ought to land in.
# bullseye  the single best pin for this entry
# core      well inside the main speaking area
# fringe    inside, but a secondary area
# near      just outside, a reasonable guess
# region    right part of the world, wrong country
# The harness checks the bands come out in order. A violation is a finding about
# the footprint or the weights, not about the player.
# Bejaia is the bullseye because it is the only Kabyle city Natural Earth
# carries, at 385k. Tizi Ouzou is the cultural heart of Kabylie and is absent
# from the dataset entirely, so it draws the rural baseline. A real gridded
# population source would put it back; this is what the limitation looks like.
